tagline: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 company that owns, operates, and develops high-quality real estate focused on healthcare discovery and delivery in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI measures the adjusted operational performance of the stable senior housing portfolio, reflecting the profitability of core properties and operational efficiency in the healthcare real estate sector.

kpis.name: Adjusted NOI - Senior Housing
kpis.explanation: Adjusted net operating income for the same-store senior housing portfolio.
kpis.description: Measures the adjusted operational profitability of the stable senior housing portfolio, excluding acquisitions and developments.

kpis.name: Average Occupancy Rate - Senior Housing
kpis.explanation: Average percentage of occupied units in the senior housing portfolio.
kpis.description: Indicates the average occupancy rate of the senior housing portfolio, reflecting demand and operational efficiency.

kpis.short: Average Annual Rent Per Occupied Unit
kpis.name: Average Annual Rent Per Occupied Unit
kpis.explanation: Average annual revenue generated per occupied housing unit in the senior housing portfolio.
kpis.description: Measures average revenue per occupied unit, reflecting rate increases and revenue optimization.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total interest expenses on the group's debt.
kpis.description: Reflects the cost of financing and the impact of debt issuances as well as interest rates.

kpis.name: Depreciation and Amortization
kpis.explanation: Depreciation and amortization charges on real estate and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Measures the annual depreciation of real estate and intangible assets resulting from acquisitions and developments.

kpis.name: General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: General management and corporate administration expenses.
kpis.description: Measures administrative operational efficiency following the merger with Physicians Realty Trust and synergies achieved.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €20.34 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €10.14 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.823 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income reported annually, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.071 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Senior Housing Portfolio Properties
kpis.explanation: Number of senior housing properties in the consolidated portfolio.
kpis.description: Number of operated senior housing communities, reflecting concentration in this key segment.

kpis.name: Senior Housing Units Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of housing units in the senior housing portfolio (10,422 units planned in Janus Living).
kpis.description: Size of the senior housing portfolio to be separated via the planned IPO of Janus Living in 2026.

kpis.short: Gain on Sales of Real Estate
kpis.name: Gain on Sales of Real Estate
kpis.explanation: Profit realized from the sale of real estate properties during the period.
kpis.description: Gains from property dispositions, reflecting portfolio sale and optimization activity in 2025.

risks.title: Changes in regulatory and government policies
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in the risk factors section with specific examples affecting life sciences tenants (NIH funding, tariffs, drug policies). Potential material impact on tenants' ability to secure financing and pay rents.

risks.title: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Directly impacts operating, financing, and construction costs. Rising interest rates and inflation affecting operators and the company itself.

risks.title: Challenges in the life sciences and laboratory sector
risks.score_rationale: Key portfolio segment affected by consolidation, international competition, demand shifts, and tenant financing challenges.

risks.title: Dependence on the financial health of tenants and operators
risks.score_rationale: Revenues depend directly on tenants' ability to meet lease and financial obligations, impacted by macroeconomic and regulatory conditions.

risks.title: Shortage of qualified labor and rising wage costs
risks.score_rationale: Affects operating costs for the company and its tenants/operators, limiting operational capacity and profitability.

risks.title: Tenant bankruptcy or insolvency risks
risks.score_rationale: Tenant insolvency leads to significant financial losses, limited legal recourse, and complexity in restructurings.

risks.title: Competition and consolidation in healthcare real estate
risks.score_rationale: The healthcare REIT industry is competitive with increasing consolidation, affecting pricing and the ability to acquire quality properties.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts.
